operators.name: pixel_unshuffle_forward

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: [N, C, H, W] where H and W are divisible by downscale_factor

semantics: Maps input tensor of shape (N, C, H, W) to output of shape (N, C*downscale_factor^2, H/downscale_factor, W/downscale_factor).
Definition: output[n, c*ds^2 + k*ds + j, h, w] = input[n, c, h*ds + k, w*ds + j] for k in [0, ds), j in [0, ds).
The operation is equivalent to torch.nn.functional.pixel_unshuffle(input, downscale_factor).
No numerical computation, only data movement; preserves dtype float32.

Runs on CUDA; input and output must be CUDA tensors. The kernel should handle arbitrary strides but may assume contiguous for performance; launcher will check contiguity and call contiguous copy if needed.
Calls F.pixel_unshuffle with positional arguments x (input tensor) and self.upscale_factor (int).
Returns a tensor of shape [N, C*ds^2, H/ds, W/ds] with reordered pixels as defined above.
The output is on the same device and dtype as input.
